newsitem.title: KENYA: CRICKET-KENYA WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST PAKISTAN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-KENYA WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST PAKISTAN.

text.p: Kenya won the toss and elected to
bat against Pakistan in their four-nations tournament one day
Kenya: Maurice Odumbe (captain), Deepak Chudasama, Kennedy
Otieno, Steve Tikolo, Sandeep Gupta, Hitesh Modi, Asif Karim,
Thomas Odoyo, Tony Suji, Edward Odumbe, Martin Suji.
Pakistan: Saeed Anwar (captain), Salim Elahi, Ramiz Raja,
Ejaz Ahmed, Salim Malik, Moin Khan, Saeed Azad, Saqlain Mushtaq,
Shahid Afridi, Waqar Younis, Shahid Nazir.
